//==
// # Cartesian geospatial coordinates

// A position on a projected map plane: easting (X) and northing (Y) from the
// projection origin. ZoneNumber identifies the UTM or grid zone, and is 0
// when the projection is not zonal.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Projected_coordinate_system)
type ProjectedCoordinate
    implements IValue
{
    Easting: Length;
    Northing: Length;
    ZoneNumber: Integer;
}
